items.title: Charlie De Vore Interview, 1962-07-04
items.q: You see, Jelly Roll knew more about it than anybody.

ctx.x: What's the place of harmony in a band?

Well, now you, this is a pretty involved thing. You see now, the bands that are playing today are, if you were looking over the whole history of New Orleans music, these are the seconds, so to speak. The real top notch professional New Orleans men had everything these guys did besides working on arrangements like the Oliver Band for instance. They say the Oliver Band down here must have really been something. A lot more fluid than the band that recorded in Chicago. But if you listen to that band in Chicago, they…
Do you know who I think was responsible for a lot of that?
